page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s2 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system deployment and data persistence. It lacks dedicated GPU hardware, containing zero graphics accelerators. Additionally, the instance does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning network connectivity must be configured via external IP allocation or NAT gateways.

An analysis of the CPU flags reveals that the underlying processor does not support advanced instruction sets. Specifically, Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration flags such as AES and SHA_NI are absent. The lack of hyper-threading and virtualization extensions further defines its hardware profile, limiting its utility for nested virtualization or vector-heavy mathematical computations.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a modest 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance represents an entry-level compute-focused option. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring predictable CPU performance without the overhead of high memory capacity or local storage. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, microservices, and simple utility tasks that do not rely on specialized hardware instructions.
